sentences.en: Hello, this is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 你好,这是6分钟英语 从英国广播公司学习英语。

sentences.en: I'm Neil. And I'm Pippa. Many of us don't think twice about where the food in our kitchen comes from.
sentences.zh: 我是尼尔,我是皮帕 我们很多人都不考虑厨房的食物来源

sentences.en: One trip to the supermarket and we can buy anything we want, whether that's fruit grown in South America, tomatoes from Spain or rice flown in from Asia.
sentences.zh: 一次去超市,我们可以买任何我们想要的东西, 无论是在南美种植的水果,西班牙的西红柿,还是亚洲的稻米。

sentences.en: Do you know where the food you buy comes from, Neil?
sentences.zh: 你知道你买的食物来自哪里吗,尼尔?

sentences.en: I try to pay attention and buy stuff that's locally produced, but actually, sometimes I don't really look.
sentences.zh: 我试着关注 并购买的东西 当地生产, 但实际上,有时我真的不看。

sentences.en: How about you? I actually have a calendar on my kitchen wall, which tells me which fruits and vegetables are grown at what times of year.
sentences.zh: 其实我厨房墙上有一张日历, 它告诉我每年什么时候种的水果和蔬菜。

sentences.en: The reality is that the supply of fresh food to the UK is fragile.
sentences.zh: 现实情况是,联合王国的新鲜食品供应十分脆弱。

sentences.en: The UK imports around 40% of its food, and this supply chain can easily be disrupted by wars, shortages and, increasingly, by climate change.
sentences.zh: 联合王国进口约40%的粮食,而这一供应链很容易因战争、短缺以及气候变化而中断。

sentences.en: In fact, the UK government's Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs recently reported on the importance of food security – the term for having a reliable enough supply of affordable, healthy food to feed everyone.
sentences.zh: 事实上,联合王国政府环境、食品和农村事务部最近报告了粮食安全的重要性 — — 即可靠地提供足够负担得起的健康食物供养每个人。

sentences.en: In this episode, we'll be investigating the issues affecting food production in the UK.
sentences.zh: 我们将调查影响英国食品生产的问题。

sentences.en: As usual, we'll learn some useful new vocabulary, and remember – there's a quiz, worksheet and transcript of this episode on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 我们将学习一些有用的新词汇, 并记住——我们网站上有这集的测验、工作表和笔录,

sentences.en: But first, of course, Pippa, I have a quiz question for you.
sentences.zh: 但首先 当然 皮帕 我有个问题要问你

sentences.en: I mentioned that Britain imports 40% of its food from other producers, mostly in Europe.
sentences.zh: 我提到,英国从其他生产商进口40%的粮食,主要在欧洲。

sentences.en: But which European country does the UK import the most food from?
sentences.zh: 但英国从哪个欧洲国家进口的粮食最多?

sentences.en: Is it: a) France, b) the Netherlands, or c) Ireland?
sentences.zh: 是:a) 法国,b) 荷兰,或c) 爱尔兰?

sentences.en: Hmm. I've seen the Netherlands on a lot of food packaging in the UK, so I'm going to say b) the Netherlands.
sentences.zh: 嗯,我在英国看到荷兰有很多食品包装, 所以我要说,(b)荷兰。

sentences.en: OK. Well, we'll find out if you're right later in the programme.
sentences.zh: 好吧,我们等会再查查你是否是对的

sentences.en: According to the UK government's recent report, there are many issues affecting Britain's food supply: geopolitical conflicts like those in Ukraine and Iran, droughts and water shortages, loss of biodiversity caused by climate change... the list goes on and on.
sentences.zh: 根据英国政府最近的报告, 有许多问题影响英国的粮食供应:乌克兰和伊朗的地缘政治冲突、干旱和缺水、气候变化造成的生物多样性丧失.

sentences.en: Here, climate reporter Mark Poynting discusses the report's conclusions with BBC Radio 4's The Food Programme.
sentences.zh: 气候记者Mark Poynting与BBC电台4的《粮食计划》讨论了报告的结论。

sentences.en: And it really draws on scientific research to come up with what it calls a reasonable worst-case scenario for how biodiversity loss could affect UK security.
sentences.zh: 它确实利用了科学研究 得出了它所谓的 合理的最坏的情景 生物多样性的丧失会如何影响英国的安全。

sentences.en: And its conclusions are really quite stark.
sentences.zh: 其结论确实非常尖锐。

sentences.en: The first line of the report says, "Global ecosystem degradation and collapse threatens the UK's national security."
sentences.zh: 报告第一行说,“全球生态系统退化和崩溃威胁到英国的国家安全。”

sentences.en: The report describes a worst-case scenario where Britain runs out of food.
sentences.zh: 报告描述了英国粮食短缺的最坏情况。

sentences.en: A worst-case scenario is the worst possible thing that could happen in a particular situation.
sentences.zh: 最坏的情况是在特定情况下可能发生的最坏的情况。

sentences.en: Mark says the report's conclusions are stark – an adjective which in this case means obvious or severe.
sentences.zh: 马克说报告的结论很尖锐,

sentences.en: Another problem with food security relates to climate change.
sentences.zh: 粮食安全的另一个问题与气候变化有关。

sentences.en: Carbon emissions from food production make up around a third of all greenhouse gases, from the diesel used to drive tractors, to fertilisers, to cows and sheep producing methane.
sentences.zh: 粮食生产产生的碳排放约占所有温室气体的三分之一,从驱动拖拉机、化肥、生产甲烷的奶牛和羊的柴油排放。

sentences.en: Emma Pinchbeck is the chief executive of the UK's Climate Change Committee.
sentences.zh: Emma Pinchbeck是英国气候变化委员会的首席执行官。

sentences.en: She spoke about this problem with BBC Radio 4's The Food Programme.
sentences.zh: 她与英国广播公司第四电台的食品节目谈到这个问题。

sentences.en: The biggest chunk of emissions from agriculture comes from simply having livestock on the land.
sentences.zh: 农业排放的最大部分来自在土地上饲养牲畜。

sentences.en: That's the bit of the puzzle that we need to think about going forward.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们需要考虑的 前进的难题。

sentences.en: And in the way that we've thought about it, for every cow or sheep we take off the land, we put on something else.
sentences.zh: 以我们思考的方式, 对于每一个母牛或绵羊,我们从这片土地上起飞, 我们换了别的东西。

sentences.en: And what that does overall is it makes farmers and landowners part of the solution to climate change, not the problem.
sentences.zh: 总的说来,它使农民和土地所有者成为气候变化解决办法的一部分,而不是问题。

sentences.en: Livestock – that's farm animals such as cattle, sheep and pigs – contribute most of the carbon emissions from agriculture.
sentences.zh: 牲畜 — — 农场动物,如牛、羊和猪 — — 占农业碳排放的大部分。

sentences.en: Moving towards a sustainable food supply involves reducing the amount of meat and dairy we eat in favour of non-animal protein such as beans and lentils.
sentences.zh: 迈向可持续的粮食供应需要减少我们吃的非动物蛋白质(如豆类和扁豆)的肉类和奶类数量。

sentences.en: Encouraging farmers and consumers to move away from meat is a piece of the puzzle, according to Emma.
sentences.zh: Emma认为,鼓励农民和消费者远离肉类是拼图的一部分。

sentences.en: A piece of the puzzle means a part of the solution to a problem – in this case, the twin problems of food security and climate change.
sentences.zh: 问题的一个部分意味着一个问题的解决方案的一部分 — — 在这种情况下,是粮食安全和气候变化的双重问题。

sentences.en: Emma says it's important to think again about how farmland is used.
sentences.zh: Emma说,重新思考农田的使用方式很重要。

sentences.en: For every cow or sheep taken off the land, something else, such as a fruit tree or vegetable crop, is put in its place.
sentences.zh: 对于从土地上夺走的每一头牛羊来说,其他的东西,例如水果树或蔬菜作物,都取代了它。

sentences.en: That way, farmers become part of the solution, not the problem – an idiom meaning that if you are not actively trying to fix a problem, you are helping it continue.
sentences.zh: 这样,农民成为解决办法的一部分,而不是问题的一部分 — — 所谓问题的意思是,如果你不积极设法解决问题,你正在帮助解决问题。

sentences.en: Lots of ideas to chew over there, Neil. But now, isn't it time you revealed the answer to your question?
sentences.zh: 那儿有很多想法要嚼,尼尔 现在,你是不是该透露你的问题的答案了?

sentences.en: My question was, "Which European country does the UK import the most food from?" And you said b) the Netherlands… and you were absolutely correct, Pippa.
sentences.zh: 我的问题是,“英国从哪个欧洲国家进口最多的食品?”你说,(b)荷兰......你完全正确,皮帕。

sentences.en: It is the Netherlands. The UK imports £7.6 billion worth of imports, especially vegetables and dairy.
sentences.zh: 这是荷兰,联合王国进口76亿英镑的进口品,特别是蔬菜和奶制品。

sentences.en: OK. Let's recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with food security – the situation where a country has a reliable enough supply of food to feed its population.
sentences.zh: 让我们回顾一下我们学到的词汇,从粮食安全开始, 一个国家有足够的食物供应来养活其人口。

sentences.en: The worst-case scenario is the worst possible thing that could happen in a particular situation.
sentences.zh: 最坏的情况是在特定情况下可能发生的最坏情况。

sentences.en: The adjective stark has several meanings, including obvious and severe.
sentences.zh: 这个形容词有几种含义,包括明显和严重的含义。

sentences.en: Livestock are animals and birds that are kept on a farm, such as cows, sheep or chickens.
sentences.zh: 牲畜是养在农场的动物和鸟类,如牛、羊或鸡。

sentences.en: The phrase a piece of the puzzle means a part of the solution to a problem.
sentences.zh: 拼图中的词语意味着解决问题的一个部分。

sentences.en: And finally, the idiom be part of the solution, not the problem means that if you are not actively trying to fix a problem, you are helping it continue.
sentences.zh: 问题不是意味着如果你不积极解决一个问题, 而是在帮助它继续。

sentences.en: Once again, our six minutes are up, but if this topic has made you hungry for more, why not check out our food topic page on our website, bbclearningenglish.com?
sentences.zh: 如果这个话题让你更渴望, 为什么不看看我们网站上的食物主题网页,bbc学习英语.

sentences.en: Bye for now! Goodbye!
sentences.zh: 再见,再见
